members.doc: The ids of the open Disclosures, when the caller controls them.

members.name: defaultExpandedIds
members.doc: The ids of the Disclosures that start open, when the group controls itself.

members.name: multiple
members.doc: Lets several Disclosures stay open at once. Turn it off to keep at most one open.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables every Disclosure in the group.

members.name: onExpandedChange
members.doc: Reports the ids of the open Disclosures, as an array of strings.
